purpose: Server-rendered category configuration dashboard for backend-owned category datasets.
businessRules: Existing category configuration must be fetched from SHRESTA-BE before rendering.
High-density category configuration must be grouped into collapsible sections so existing datasets can be scanned before editing.
Forms expose backend-owned editable fields including metadata, allowed values, tax dates, and styling rules.
Visible form labels use operations wording such as Advanced Details JSON and Facet Mapping while preserving required metadata/backendMapping payload fields.
Snake-case keys, backend mappings, and HSN codes use shared regex patterns from src/lib/input-patterns.ts.
Category configuration is saree-focused and must stay saree-only.
Mutations use server actions with idempotency and revalidate this route after success.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render AdminApiUnavailable instead of the Next runtime overlay.
